_source: Colors: Extron's Afterburn theme guide, transcribed in docs/design-rules.md section 4, checked control by control against seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl (the grammar measurement of 2026-10-22: every page and popup read with gdl.project): its 13 distinct fills, strokes and captions are #FFFFFF, #242634, #BABCCE, #37394E, #767789, #D69B61, #6A6E89, #D32A2A, #D32929, #191919, #000000, #AFB0BE and #242633. `accent` captions a selected text-only button on Main Multi-Window (Window 1, Window 2), Doc Cam (its inputs) and VTC Search Results (its rows); `shape` outlines VTC Search Results' list card and rings the d-pads on Streaming and Camera Settings; `alert` is the red of Main Recording's record icon, and the #D32A2A stroke of Main VC's Start Sharing when it is On.

Type: seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl's labels and captions on every page and popup, by size and weight (the grammar measurement of 2026-10-22): 38 pt for Start's room name; 23.5 bold for the entry readouts on VTC Keyboard and TV; 21 for the 28 titles, questions and waits (Select a Source on Main Select Source, PC, Blu-ray, Camera Select, Confirmation); 20 bold for the 62 keyboard and keypad keys on VTC Keyboard; 16 regular white for the rail headings (Display, Settings, Lights, Volume); 16 bold #BABCCE capitals for the group labels in popups (INPUTS, ZOOM on Doc Cam; MIC, PROGRAM on Audio Settings); and the buttons at 13 pt (94: the sources, Preview, Video Conference) and 17 (Press to begin, Doc Cam's inputs).

Borders: the border resources of seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl's controls - 'Afterburn - 10 Radius 2 Thick' on the outlined buttons and VTC Search Results' list card, 'Afterburn - 10 Radius 0 Thick' on Camera Settings' zoom keys, 'Afterburn - Elipse 0 Thick' on the keypad keys' pressed circles and Power's On fill, 'Afterburn - 14 Radius 0 Thick' on the slider, and '2D Rectangle' only on Video Preview's video.
Point sizes draw at 1.375 px per point, GUI Designer's 99 DPI (gdl/compose.py PT).
A level: every Afterburn seed's Level (300M, 320, 525) is 15 px across, its fill gaugeFillColorField in accent-2 - Build draws a Level over its whole box, so the box is the rail.

Slider and level: the seed's built sliders (Audio Settings) - a 10 px rail (SliderTrackWidth) in a 50 x 395 control, the empty rail the control's fill (#242634, TLPMinValueImageID), the filled rail #BABCCE (TLPMaxValueImageID), a 50 px #626ACF thumb (SliderIndicatorImageID) - matching the guide's track, slider-fill and secondary-accent rows.

Panel: the one container seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl draws as a control, VTC Search Results' list card (156,75 345x385) - raised fill, #6A6E89 stroke, Afterburn - 10 Radius 2 Thick - and the guide's 'shapes #6A6E89' row. The squircle behind every page, and a modal's card, are art.

Themes: the guide's four background images and Extron's recommended accent scheme for each (Default + 1, Anthracite + 3, Blue Slate + 2, Grape + 4; guide pp.8-9), from the resource kit's Backgrounds/6400x4000/TLP 1025 & 1220 files - the variant the seed's own 6400x4000_bg1.png was made from (its recorded filename and byte size match). The image is the raised card that elevates the page's main area, transparent around it so the page color shows.

Layout: each series' working page, measured into its `panels` entry's `frame` off its seed by tests/measure_series.py frame_of - Main SD on the 1020 to 1720 Series, with seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl's Main Select Source, Start, Main VC, Main Multi-Window, Main Recording and Help read beside it - from which the README's Layout is written. Every page puts its task in the background image's squircle (art, not a control) between a left rail and a right rail.

Buttons: seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl's Main SD, Main Select Source, Main Multi-Window, Main VC, Main Recording, Start, VTC Dialer, VTC Search Results, Doc Cam, Help and Confirmation, every button state read with gdl.project: the sources 110x110 (the tabs across Main SD, the row on Main Select Source), the rail's list and toggle rows 178x50 every 58 px, Help and Power 64x64, the outlined buttons 144x64 or 154x64, the keypad keys 64x64 pressing to a circle. Image buttons and the kit: every image button in the Afterburn 1035 and 1535 seeds - the kit file on each state (buttonImageField), drawn Fill and MiddleCenter, with no border resource; the fill, caption and indent each archetype uses; and the kit's own naming (Resources/Afterburn/Buttons/PNG: <size>_<icon>_nsel for unselected, <size>_<icon>-<accent>_sel per accent). Icon anatomy: the guide's p.4. The Close, Back, More, arrow, d-pad, transport and zoom glyphs are characters of the Extron-Afterburn font on the seed's buttons (Close Help, Search Result Scroll Up), not kit images there; the kit draws most of them as images in Resources/Afterburn/Icons/PNG (close, Chevron, Carets, minus, plus, more - the same drawings, rendered from Extron - Afterburn 1a.ttf beside them), which the kit root here, Buttons/PNG, does not read.

Slider thumb: the kit's 440x440_thumb-1 draws its circle across 286 of 440 px (65%), and the seed's built 50 px thumb shows a circle 31-32 px across - so the canvas draws the kit's own thumb, not a circle the size of the box.
title: Extron Afterburn
tagline: Extron's Afterburn touch-panel template, for TLP Pro panels.

colors.name: page
colors.usage: Page and popup background; a slider or level's empty track over an image, or on a raised panel.

colors.name: raised
colors.usage: Button fill when idle; the list card (VTC Search Results'), outlined in `shape`; a slider or level's empty track over a color. The squircle every page sits on is not a panel: it is the background image's art.

colors.name: pressed
colors.usage: Button fill when pressed or selected (the On state). The same value as page.

colors.name: text
colors.usage: Titles (a popup's or modal's, a confirmation's question), rail headings, button captions, paragraphs, the Start page's clock; the border of a pressed outlined button. On page, raised and pressed.

colors.name: text-secondary
colors.usage: The date and time on a working page, divider lines, the border of an idle outlined button, the filled part of a slider, the group labels in a popup (INPUTS, ZOOM), single-color icons. On page and raised.

colors.name: text-subtle
colors.usage: Icon secondary in the guide: the de-emphasised parts of an icon. Under 4.5:1 on page and raised, so never for text people have to read.

colors.name: shape
colors.usage: Container shapes: the outline of a list card (over a raised fill) and the ring round a d-pad; a toggle's thumb when off.

colors.name: accent
colors.usage: Selection lines and selected icons - the kit's `_sel` images draw both, in the scheme's accent - and the caption of a selected text-only button (Window 1 and Window 2, Doc Cam's inputs, a search result). Not a fill: Afterburn never fills a button with it. One scheme per project.

colors.name: accent-2
colors.usage: A slider's thumb and a level's fill (the guide's secondary accent). One scheme per project.

colors.name: alert
colors.usage: A live state: the stroke of a sharing button while it is live (Start Sharing and Stop Share draw #D32A2A when On) and the kit's red record icon (#D32929). Afterburn never fills a button red and never colors a caption red - it shows state with icons and strokes. The red is the seed's own record icon's.

colors.name: scrim
colors.usage: What the panel shows behind a modal popup's card: the page beneath, under black at 65% (alpha 166). Build draws a modal black at its own transparency - 35%, which every template's modals are authored at and the spec writes on every modal - whatever background it was given, measured on the Afterburn, Mach and Shockwave seeds and on a panel built from a canvas - so it is not one of a panel's six colors. The guide's #242634 at 20% transparency is not what ships.

type.name: title
type.usage: The room's name on the Start page: Open Sans 38, the largest label. The working pages have no title of their own.

type.name: heading
type.usage: An entry readout - the TV popup's channel, the keyboard's address: 23.5 pt bold. A popup's or a modal's title is the `subheading`.

type.name: subheading
type.usage: A popup's or a modal's title, a confirmation's question, a wait's sentence and the hub's Select a Source: 21 pt regular, in `text` (the Label's default).

type.name: button-large
type.usage: The caption of a keypad or keyboard key: 20 pt bold. Sources and actions caption smaller in the template (13 pt; Press to begin 17 pt, so set its `size`).

type.name: body
type.usage: Labels, status and paragraphs; the clock; a rail group's heading (Display, Settings, Lights, Volume) in Title case and `text`.

type.name: body-strong
type.usage: A group label inside a popup or a modal: capitals in `text-secondary` (INPUTS, ZOOM, PAN / TILT, MIC) - set the color, since a Label's default is `text` - or a field label that ends in a colon (TITLE:).

type.name: button
type.usage: The caption of a small button. Afterburn's own small buttons use 13 pt, under the 14 pt minimum the toolkit checks, so 14 is the floor here.

afterburn.usage: An outlined button: rounded, with its stroke drawn.

afterburn-flat.usage: A rounded fill with no stroke: ghost buttons (the zoom keys) and a hairline divider (the search list's). A card is `afterburn`, with its stroke.

rect.usage: A square-cornered fill: the template draws it only on its video window.

afterburn-ellipse.usage: An icon button's pressed fill: a circle behind the icon (guide Fig. 7).

none.usage: No border at all: a kit image button, whose image draws the whole button.

outlined.usage: The default button: a raised fill and a text-secondary border, pressed fill and a white border when On. The seed's most common look. With an `icon` the icon sits at its left and the caption after it (Make Call, Swap, Contacts); with an icon and no caption, the icon is centered (a keyboard key). A selected text-only one can show its caption in `accent` (Window 1, Doc Cam's inputs).

ghost.usage: No fill until pressed or selected: the dialer's and the TV keypad's keys, the zoom - and + and the search-result rows. The template's tabs and rail rows are `source` and `list` image buttons, not ghost; its keys press to a circle, so give such a key an On `border` of `afterburn-ellipse`.

inverse.usage: For a button sitting on a raised panel: pressed fill when idle, raised when On.

source.usage: A horizontal list button: a large icon with its label under it, for choosing a source or a camera. Selected, it takes the pressed fill and the kit draws the icon in the accent with an accent line along the bottom. The tabs across a working page and the hub's sources are these, 110x110 in a row.
source.caption: below

list.usage: A vertical list button: an icon, then its label, for a set of options down the left rail (Display, Lighting, Make Call, End Call). Selected, it takes the raised fill and the kit draws the icon in the accent with an accent line down the left. The rail's rows are these, 178x50 every 58 px.
list.caption: indent

icon.usage: An icon button: the icon alone, no outline, for a stand-alone control (Help, Power, the mute under the volume slider). Pressed, the icon in the accent where the kit has a selected one (Help's), and a round fill behind it: pressed, as the guide's Fig. 7 draws it, where the template's own are Power's raised and Help's none. A mute that shows the volume has four states - Muted, then Level 1 to 3 - not Off and On. The seed's are 64x64.
icon.caption: none

tile.usage: A hub's Select a Source tile: its seed's own 756x688 art - the source's icon over a plate a little shorter than the `source` tile's - with no caption of its own, its name a 13 pt label inside its foot. The 520's template draws it in orange alone, so on another accent, or for a source its seed draws none of, the hub takes the `source` tile. Drawn by the hub; not one to draw yourself.
tile.caption: none

toggle.usage: A toggle: its label at the left and the switch at the right, for turning one thing on or off (a display's power, a mute). The thumb moves and takes the secondary accent when On. The seed's are 178x50.
toggle.caption: indent

alert.usage: A live action: an outlined button whose On state draws its stroke red, as Start Sharing and Stop Share do while sharing is live. Only the stroke is red - Afterburn never fills a button red or colors a caption red.

kit.note: Extron's Afterburn resource kit. Each icon comes unselected (`off`) and selected in each accent's color; a family drawn in the primary accents (orange, light-blue, gold, med-blue) selects in the scheme's primary, one drawn in the secondary accents (periwinkle, light-green, gold) - toggles, volume levels - in its secondary.
kit.extract_note: The 520's Select a Source tiles are its seed's own art, in no kit folder: 756x688_<source>_nsel is the kit's 756x756 with its top 68 rows cut off, and 756x688_<source>-orange_sel a redrawn plate, in orange alone (seeds/Afterburn 525.gdl's Select Source). `python -m gdl.designsys extract afterburn` writes them beside the kit's buttons.
kit.icons_note: The kit's Icons/PNG, beside its Buttons/PNG (no file name is in both): 440x440 drawings of the template's icon font (Font/Extron - Afterburn 1a.ttf, whose glyphs `close`, `chevron_left`, `caret_up`, `plus` draw the same), each one file, named here by its stem - a caret in a gray and a dark-gray file, `caret-up-gray` and `caret-up-dark-gray`. The seeds draw them as that font's glyphs - seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl's Close Help in #BABCCE, seeds/Afterburn 525.gdl's Help Back chevron and its Main page's Volume Up and Down carets, seeds/Afterburn 320.gdl's Doc Cam 1 More and Doc Cam 2 Back, and its Doc Cam 1 zoom minus and plus; the system draws the kit's drawing of each, fitted to its button, since the font carries no license field. Only these families are indexed, so the bundle carries a few dozen of the 657.
kit.icon_right_note: How far across a 1224x344 `list` image its icon reaches: the icons' light pixels end at x 399 of 1224 at most - privacy the furthest, the median 366 - over the 278 files in the install's kit. The screen-up and screen-down arrows (from x 968) and the recording keys' play, stop, record, mark and pause glyphs (from 918) stand at the art's right, past any caption, and are left out. A region gives a `list` button's caption the leading spaces that start it 4 px clear of that reach, at the cell's own width and the panel's type, where the template counts a fixed 15 at its own 13 pt.
kit.switch_left_note: Where a `toggle` image's switch starts: x 637 of 1224 on 1224x344 and 701 of 1224 on 1224x464 (the 1020's 132x50 cells), its light pixels at rest (toggle-1_nsel, toggle-2_nsel). A region starts a toggle's caption 8 px in and ends it 4 px before the switch, where the template counts 4 leading spaces.

cover.pattern: rounded tiles cut at the Afterburn 10 px radius

iconography.icon_prop: The kit draws each icon unselected and selected in every accent, with the selection line where the variant has one, so the button's states show themselves: state 0 unselected, the rest selected in the page's accent.
iconography.intro: Afterburn shows state with icons, not with colored text. Every icon the kit has comes from Afterburn's own resource kit through a Button's `icon` - never draw one, and never color a caption red. The template's Close, Back, More, d-pad, transport, zoom, scroll and screen arrows are glyphs in its Extron-Afterburn icon font, which the design system does not carry. The kit draws most of them as images too, in Afterburn/Icons/PNG - Close's X, Back's and More's chevrons, the scroll and volume triangles (Carets), minus, plus, the More dots and most of the transport keys - and the system offers those drawings by their file's name (`kit.icons`) - `close`, `back`, `more`, `chevron-left` and `chevron-right`, the carets in their gray and dark gray (`caret-up-gray`, `caret-down-dark-gray`), `plus`, `minus`, `dot` and the transport keys - each fitted to its button: a Close is `variant="icon" icon="close"`.
rules: **Anatomy** (the guide's p.4): a `text-secondary` (#BABCCE) stroke and primary elements, `text-subtle` (#767789) secondary elements, an `icon-ground` (#414459) background inside the icon, and - selected - the supporting element in the accent. The kit already draws all of this, for every accent scheme.

**Which button**: a stand-alone control (Help, Power, mute) is `variant="icon"`, 64x64. Sources and cameras are `source`, a row of squares with the label under the icon. Options down the left rail are `list`, a selection line at the left when chosen - Make Call, End Call and Privacy among them. On and off is `toggle`. An important action with a label is `outlined` with an `icon` (Make Call, Swap).

**Feedback**: state 0 draws the icon unselected, the others selected - in the accent, with the variant's selection line and fill. A single-image icon (`power`, `call_connected`) still shows it is pressed.

**Red** is a live state, not a fill: a sharing button goes red-stroked while it is live (`variant="alert"`), and the record icon is red. Afterburn never fills a button red; an ordinary action, even a final one like shutting the room down, is an outlined button.

start.attrs: name="Start" size="17" nav="MainSD" does="Starts the room and shows the sources."

examples.states_note: In Afterburn a state shows itself with its icon: the kit's selected image draws the icon in the accent, with the selection line for a list button, and the button takes the pressed fill. A text-only button that is selected shows its caption in `accent`. Never color a caption red.

camera._source: seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl's Doc Cam popup: its ZOOM Label 120x50 at 279,73 over Zoom Tele and Zoom Wide, 154x64 at 262,135 and 262,214; the kit's plus and minus stand for its zoom glyphs.

examples.group_note: Both defaults are Afterburn's own source row: four 110x110 buttons, 49 px apart. Extron's own paged list, VTC Search Results, scrolls with up and down triangles beside it, and its 320 pages a device with More and a Back chevron in the footer - glyphs of its icon font, which the kit draws as images too (Afterburn/Icons/PNG's Carets and Chevron) and this system offers by name. A Group that pages draws its Previous and Next as the kit's chevrons (`regions.group`: chevron-left and chevron-right), each a touch-minimum key under its cells - the glyph the 320 pages with, in the toolkit's place for it.
examples.color_rule: `page` behind everything; `raised` for idle buttons and the one list card the template draws, with `shape` outlining it (the squircle itself is the background image); `pressed` and a `text` border for On; `text` for titles, headings and captions and `text-secondary` for the date and time and a popup's group labels; `accent` only through the kit's selected icons and selection lines, and the caption of a selected text-only button; `alert` only as the red stroke of a live action, never a fill or a caption; `accent-2` is the slider thumb, a level's fill and a toggle's thumb.

themes.name: Default
themes.usage: The Default background with accent scheme 1: Extron's recommended pairing, and the seed's own.

themes.name: Anthracite
themes.usage: The Anthracite background with accent scheme 3, as Extron recommends.

themes.name: Blue Slate
themes.usage: The Blue Slate background with accent scheme 2, as Extron recommends.

themes.name: Grape
themes.usage: The Grape background with accent scheme 4, as Extron recommends.

layout.region_frame_note: Afterburn's chrome is its background art (no `bars`), and its working page is the bar themes' grammar all the same (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-26-afterburn-regions-design.md): its region components draw from each series' measured frame - the sources over the Divider at the squircle's top as the Header, the left rail's groups as the LeftRail, the right column's volume as the RightRail, the foot row (`foot`) as the Footer, the popup region as the Center - painting no surfaces, since the art draws the squircle round them.
layout.start: Afterburn's panel boots to Start, its seed's DefaultPage: a splash page in the squircle - the room's name, Press to begin and one centred date and time - with lighting presets under a Lights heading in the left rail and the volume in the right, from which its working pages are reached. Draw its words and Start in the squircle's `MainArea`, and its presets as a `Group`.
layout.main_note: The central squircle: the card the background image draws - a vertical gradient from #4F4C6B to #3A364D with a drop shadow, art rather than a panel - 183-1099 across and 24-776 down on a 1280x800 page (the image's opaque body, measured).
regions: **A working page is the squircle between two rails.** Across the top of the squircle runs the row of sources (`source` buttons, 110x110: the Header's tabs) over a divider, which the Header draws. Under it the popup region (the Center) shows the selected source's controls, each source a standard popup of its own group (`role="source"`). At the foot are the date at the left, the one outlined Preview in the middle and the time at the right, in `text-secondary`; Preview opens the room's video preview, so draw it only where the room has one. The page has no title of its own: each popup carries its source's name as a centred `subheading` Label at its top - the Center draws it, and the empty state - and a source with no controls says `PC is currently selected.` and `There are no controls for this device.` The 1020 Series draws no Preview and one combined date-and-time Clock at its foot.

**Start and Main Select Source are not working pages.** Start is the page the panel boots into, so name it `Start` and mark it `start="true"` (its file is still `Main.dc.html`, as the canvas names its entry): the room's name (`title`) above the squircle's middle, `Press to begin` in its vertical middle (an outlined button, 17 pt), lighting presets under a `Lights` heading in the left rail and the Volume heading, slider and Mute in the right rail (no Help or Power), and one combined date-and-time Clock, in `text`, at its foot. Main Select Source, the hub that follows it, puts the four sources in the middle of the squircle under a centred `subheading`, `Select a Source`. On the 520 and 535 the template's Start draws its squircle too, between a Lights rail and a Volume rail; the system builds every page of those panels on their Main art, so there a Start page is laid out in the hub's main region.

**The left rail (x 0-183) holds groups:** a `body` Label heading per group in Title case (Display, Settings, Lights, VTC, Screen, Recording) at x 14, and under it `list` and `toggle` buttons 178x50 at x 0, one every 58 px - the kit's art fills each button, so the rail has no ghost button. Its foot holds the page's own outlined button, 144x64 at 20,706, only where the room has a mode or a window for it: Video Conference and Presentation switch the room's mode; Window Layout (Multi-Window) and Recording Controls (Recording) open a window; Start has none. Main Recording also keeps its record status, the record icon and the elapsed time, in the rail's top-left corner.

**The right rail (x 1099-1280) holds the volume and the system controls**, its column centred on x 1193: a `Volume` heading level with the left rail's first heading, the vertical slider (Afterburn draws it 50x395 at 1168,202; the RightRail draws it at the 53 px touch minimum the toolkit checks, and a Rail 54 wide) with Mute at its foot, and Help and Power side by side below, Help at 1125,706 and Power at 1197,706 (Start has neither). The slot at the top, y 30, is the page's own: Start Sharing (outlined, 144x64 at 1121,30) on a video-conference page, Window 1 and Window 2 (82x64) on a multi-window page, empty on the others.

The 1230 Series splits its squircle with a vertical divider: a Preview half at the left (the preview tabs, the video and Send to Display) and, at the right, the source tabs and the popup region the Layout gives. A full-page grid of controls is a working panel but not an Afterburn one.
layout.popups: On Afterburn's working page one source's controls are a standard popup of its own group in that region (the template's group 1; `Sources` here, the `PopupRegion`'s `group`), swapped in by the source buttons while the page stays; a page flip is for a mode of the room (a call) and for Start to the hub. A modal popup (`kind="modal"`) shows the page beneath, dimmed: Help, the confirmations and a set of settings opened from a page - Screen, Lighting, Audio and Display Settings, Camera Select, Window Layout, Recording Controls, presets - are modals on the 1020, 1220, 1230, 1520 and 1720 Series, as the templates draw them there; the 520 and 535 draw them as standard popups filling main, each with a Back chevron, and the 300M as pages. A modal's own card is the template's squircle art, a full-canvas image under its title: a window with a `role` (`settings`, `help`, `confirm`, `wait`) draws it itself, as the page's own background art for its panel and theme (`<name> Background`), with the template's title, Close, message and answers where its frame has them; for a modal without a role, which a Page cannot give that art, put a `Panel` inside as the nearest card the system draws - the squircle's own 916x752 at 183,24, in the Panel's default look - and its words and buttons on it, where the Layout's windows give them. A card with a title (Help, a set of settings) has a Close at its top right: `nav` back to the page that opens it, or, where more than one page opens it, no `nav` and `does="Closes this popup."` - the program hides it and the page beneath shows again; the template's Close is a glyph of its icon font, which the design system does not carry, and the kit draws it as an image too (Afterburn/Icons/PNG's close), which this system offers: a Close is `variant="icon" icon="close"`, the X fitted to its button. A confirmation has neither title nor Close, only its question and two outlined buttons, the affirmative first (Power Down, Cancel; Accept, Decline), and a wait (Starting Up, Powering Down) is one sentence with no buttons.
layout.rail_note: Afterburn's own right column is not one stack, which a Rail is: its Volume heading stands level with the left rail's first heading, the slider runs under it, Mute overlaps the slider's foot, an empty band follows, and Help and Power sit side by side in one row. A Rail stacks them on every panel, the one the canvas is drawn on too: put the column's controls in it in the template's order - the Volume heading, the Slider, Mute, Help and Power - with no positions, and it stands them down the right rail, Help and Power one over the other where the template sets them side by side (the README's Differences). Where a panel's seed has no slider, Extron arranges the volume its own way: the 520 and 535 stand Up and Down together at the top of a column with Mute at its foot, beside a full-height level (on Main the level is a separate Volume Level popup, 50x480 at 637,0), with triangle glyphs from its icon font, which the design system does not carry - the kit draws those triangles as images too (Afterburn/Icons/PNG's Carets), which this system offers by name (`caret-up-gray`, `caret-down-gray`), though a Rail's level still steps with `-` and `+`; only the 300M uses minus and plus, in a row with Mute under a horizontal level. A Rail builds the level between Down and Up buttons that say `-` and `+`. A region page is not a Rail: its RightRail and Footer stand the column as the template does - the Volume heading level with the left rail's first, Mute at the slider's foot, Help and Power side by side in the foot row - and a hub's region page draws its menu bar's Up and Down with the kit's carets. The 320 draws no volume, Help or Power on screen: its footer is the page's name with More and a Back chevron, and its volume a modal Volume Level; the 300 Portrait's footer holds Settings, Help and Power with the volume in the main region, and the 300 Landscape's right column holds Settings, Help and Power. A Rail across the 320's foot is the toolkit's, not the template's.

regions._source: What the region components draw by default on Afterburn (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-26-afterburn-regions-design.md), off seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl's Main SD as its built layout.json draws it: its sources `source` tiles over the Divider; its left rail's first group `toggle`s (Display Power, Display Mute) and its later groups `list` launchers (Screen, Lighting, Audio), each group's heading a white 16 pt Label set left (TextAlignment 4) at the group's left; the Volume heading centred over its column (TextAlignment 3); Mute, Help and Power the kit's 440x440 icons on no fill, Mute (Main Volume Mute, 8021) its speaker-volume glyph in the scheme's secondary accent while live (its Level 3 state) and its speaker-mute-1 glyph in the primary while muted (its Muted state, the first); the foot row's mode launcher (Video Conference) and Preview outlined, 13 pt; the date set left and the time right in #BABCCE (`text-secondary`), 16 pt - 'MMMM d' and 'h:mm tt' - and on the 725 one date and time centred, 'MMMM d, yyyy h:mm:ss tt'. `rail` is a LeftRail's first group's, `launcher` its later groups', `mode` the Footer's mode slot's, `preview` its Preview's, `clocks` each clock the panel's template draws, by its name there.

mute.does: Mutes the program audio; On while muted.

regions._call: What a call page (role="call"), its dialer (role="dialer"), the incoming call's question (topic="call") and the page sources are chosen on (role="select") draw, off seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl's Main VC, VTC Dialer, Incoming Call and Main Select Source: Make Call and End Call `list` art whose lit state is another drawing (make-call_unavailable to make-call_available, end-call_disconnected to end-call_connected), Privacy the `list` privacy; Share Content (Start Sharing) outlined at the right rail's head, its On stroke red (`alert`); the dialer's digits keys with no fill until pressed (#242634, `pressed`), its Call, Swap and Contacts outlined with their 1059x440 icons, Keyboard outlined with its 440x440 icon and Delete the bare 440x440 icon; the question's Accept and Decline outlined; a source's tile the `source` tile it is on the working page, under the centred 21 pt 'Select a Source'.
regions._hub: What the 525's region page, its source popups and its windows draw in its hub's grammar, off seeds/Afterburn 525.gdl's Main, Select Source, Settings, Display Settings, Lighting Settings, Help and a source's popup (its built layout.json): the menu bar's Volume heading 16 pt bold and centred, its Up and Down outlined 66x66 keys with the icon font's carets (here the kit's caret-up-gray and caret-down-gray), Mute outlined with its speaker-mute-2 art, Help, Settings and Power the kit's 440x440 icons; every popup's Back the icon font's chevron at 0,13 (here the kit's chevron-left) and its title after it, 21 pt white set left; Select a Source's tiles its own 756x688 art (extracted, `kit.extract`; in orange alone, so another accent or a family it lacks takes the source tile), each caption a 13 pt label inside the tile's foot; Settings a column of its rail's `list` launchers at 52,83 every 58 px, Lighting Settings two columns 262 px apart (123 and 385); Display Settings its members down the column at 123,145 under a 16 pt bold #BABCCE heading in capitals at 133,83 (DISPLAY 1), opened from Settings' Display (8214); Help a popup in main, its message 68,147; the Volume Level strip's level filled in the scheme's accent-2 (`level.bar`), as the seed's #626ACF is its orange scheme's.
regions._page: What the 320's region page, its source pages and its windows draw, off seeds/Afterburn 320.gdl's Main, Doc Cam 1, Doc Cam 2, Laptop, Confirmation and Powering Down (its built layout.json): a strip along the foot with no ground, the page's title in it 17.5 pt white set left, its More the icon font's chevron (here the kit's chevron-right) at the strip's right with a 'More' label beside it set right, its Back the chevron left at the strip's left with the title moved past it; the column headings 10 pt bold #BABCCE capitals centred over outlined keys 108x45; a source with no controls one label of three lines, 12 pt white centred; the question and the wait on the page's own ground, their words 12 pt white centred, Power Down and Cancel outlined.
regions._center: What a source popup (role="source") and a window draw, off seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl's Laptop and Doc Cam popups, Help, Confirmation, Powering Down and Lighting Settings: a source's title centred at the popup's top, white, 21 pt, over no well and no fill, the labels over its keys 16 pt bold #BABCCE capitals (ZOOM, FOCUS), and with nothing in it the template's two-line empty state centred, 16 pt; a window's card the page's own background art over the whole screen (its `Background` image), its title centred at the squircle's top, 21 pt, the labels over a group in it 16 pt bold #BABCCE capitals (MIC, PROGRAM), its Close the icon font's X at the squircle's top right - drawn as the kit's 440x440 close on no fill, pressed round on `pressed` - its message centred, 16 pt (the question 21), Power Down and Cancel outlined. Those sizes are the 1035's: each panel's own template's are its frame's `pt`.

voice._source: Off seeds/Afterburn 1035.gdl's working pages, popups and windows - Main SD, Main VC, Main Recording, the Laptop and PC popups, Lighting Settings, Camera Settings, Confirmation, Starting Up, Powering Down and Help - and the grammar digest of every Afterburn page: its captions, rail headings, titles and messages. Press to begin is its one sentence-case button; the group labels inside its popups and windows are capitals, 16 pt bold Labels, not captions.
rules: A caption is Title Case: Video Conference, Presentation, Start Sharing, Make Call, End Call, Privacy, Power Down, Cancel, Accept, Decline, Record. Press to begin is the one sentence-case button.
A rail heading is one noun: Display, Settings, Lights, VTC, Screen, Recording, Volume; the rows under it short nouns or verbs: Power, Mute, Screen, Lighting, Audio.
A window's title is the thing and Settings (Lighting Settings, Display Settings) or the device's name (Blu-ray, Doc Cam, Laptop).
The labels over a group inside a popup or a window are capitals: MIC, PROGRAM, LIGHTS, DISPLAY 1.
A question names the action on its first button and Cancel on the second: Power Down, Cancel; Accept, Decline.

_source: Series, sizes, DPI and tier: GUI Designer's own TemplateInfoTable.config, through gdl/templates.py; each series' models are the MODELS_FULL models gdl.templates.template_for gives it (by model, never by resolution alone: Afterburn has no 720 template, so no TLP720T row).

main: the opaque body (alpha 255) of the series' main-page background art, mapped onto the canvas the way the template's page draws it (fit: Fill or Stretch). No control draws the squircle; the image does. The 1220's is the profile's own earlier measurement (183, not 182 - both end at 1099).
rail: what the canvas leaves beside the main region - right of it on every series that has room, below it (a footer, running across) on the 320 and the portrait 300.

popup: the template's standard popup region, where it fills a quarter of the canvas or more. It is null where the largest popup fills under a quarter of the canvas: the 1230's 650x500 fills 94% of one, and is held by its frame's `center.region`, the Layout's Popup region.

backgrounds: the kit's four page backgrounds per size, for the main page (the 520 and 535 split theirs into _start and _main; a working page takes _main). image is the name the template gives its default; the others take the kit file's name. The 1720 draws the 1520's 6830x3840 art, as its template does. A 520's or 535's Start page draws its squircle on the `_start` art, between a Lights rail and a Volume rail; the table's `main` is the Main page's, which every page of those panels is built on.

seeds, kinds, borders: each seed in seeds/ by part number and canvas (both 300M seeds are one part, either way up), and one of a model's other way up where no template is drawn so - a turned seed - under its panel (TLP1035M-Portrait) - what control kinds it can clone (the 525, 320 and 300M seeds have levels and no slider; the 320 has no standard popup), and each profile border it lacks mapped to its own of the same thickness and nearest radius.

frame: the series' working page in its template's own grammar, off its own seed (tests/measure_series.py frame_of; --frame prints each); its keys are docs/claude-design.md section 2's *Frame*. Afterburn's working page is Main SD, with no top or bottom bar: its art draws the centre (main), the source tabs across the centre's top, and the columns either side are the rails. The 520's is its Main, a hub; the 320's its Doc Cam 1 and the 300s' their Computer, each standing around its own page's art.
